methodology_note: Cross-source: NCRB PSI 2022 undertrial counts (Table 2.11C, STATES+UTs subtotals) divided by Census 2011 national religious population times 100,000. NCRB 'others' bucket (Buddhist/Jain/Parsi/not-stated) omitted, with no clean population denominator. Caveat: Maharashtra did not report religion for ~33k undertrials; the religion-reported numerator excludes those, so rates are mildly understated.
